concept: Grounded Chinese female detective protagonist for a contemporary cinematic crime mini-series.

brief.name: Chen Liyun
face: faint sun spot on left cheekbone
slightly crooked nose from old boxing injury
soft jawline with faint laugh lines
pale olive East Asian skin tone
hair: uneven layers from self-cutting during busy cases
faint premature gray streaks at temples
usually pulled back in messy half-up ponytail
body: broad shoulders from martial arts training
faint 5cm scar on right forearm from on-duty knife attack
slightly stooped posture from hunching over case files
calloused fingertips from handling firearms and evidence
outfit: oversized washed dark gray utility jacket
worn faded black cotton crewneck undershirt
high-waisted charcoal cargo pants with knee patches
thick gray wool socks peeking over boot tops
accessories: scratched silver steel watch (gift from late partner)
worn brown leather badge holder on belt clip
black half-frame reading glasses on shirt collar
frayed black hair tie on left wrist
chipped navy reusable coffee cup clipped to bag strap
